joshua.7.p1.b1.text: The Israelites, however, acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi … of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart. So the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites.

joshua.7.p1.b2.text: “Go up and spy out the land.”

joshua.7.p1.b3.text: “There is no need to send all the people; two or three thousand men are enough to go up and attack Ai. Since the people of Ai are so few …

joshua.7.p2.b1.text: So about three thousand men went up …

joshua.7.p2.b2.text: … but they fled before the men of Ai.

joshua.7.p2.b3.text: … So the hearts of the people melted and became like water.

joshua.7.p3.b1.text: Then Joshua tore his clothes … as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.

joshua.7.p3.b2.text: … fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening …

joshua.7.p3.b3.text: “O, Lord GOD, … why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be destroyed? …

joshua.7.p3.b4.text: … Then what will You do for Your great name?”

joshua.7.p4.b1.text: “Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face? Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction. …

joshua.7.p4.b2.text: … I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.

joshua.7.p4.b3.text: ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, … Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. …

joshua.7.p4.b4.text: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. … the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.

joshua.7.p5.b1.text: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.

joshua.7.p5.b2.text: … and the clan of the Zerahites was selected. … and the family of Zabdi was selected.

joshua.7.p5.b3.text: … and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

joshua.7.p6.b1.text: “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him. I urge you to tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”

joshua.7.p6.b2.text: “It is true, … I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel.

joshua.7.p6.b3.text: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them.

joshua.7.p6.b4.text: … They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”

joshua.7.p7.b1.text: So Joshua sent messengers who ran to the tent …

joshua.7.p7.b2.text: … and there it all was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.

joshua.7.p7.b3.text: They took the things from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and spread them out before the LORD.

joshua.7.p8.b1.text: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the cloak, the bar of gold … and everything else he owned, and brought them to the Valley of Achor.

joshua.7.p8.b2.text: “Why have you brought this trouble upon us? … Today the LORD will bring trouble upon you!”

joshua.7.p8.b3.text: And they heaped over Achan a large pile of rocks that remains to this day. So the LORD turned from His burning anger. Therefore that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.
